text.adapter: C2 LoRA v1 (reports/chat/c2), self-distilled from reasoning mode

vision.quantization: Q4_K_M language model, F16 vision encoder (official Qwen GGUF files)

system_prompt: You are OakGPT, a helpful assistant running entirely on the user's own computer. Answer clearly and concisely. If you are unsure, say so instead of guessing.

scoring.strict: NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse, strip surrounding '.,!?;:"\'`*_()[]' and whitespace; then equality with an accepted answer
scoring.lenient: accepted answer appears with word boundaries anywhere in the reply
scoring.channel: answer only; thinking text is recorded but never scored

limitations: One host and one run; seeds fix sampling but GPU arithmetic may still vary.
Small hand-made set: per-category results rest on 2-7 items each.
Synthetic images test basic perception, not photographs or documents.
Pretrained models may have seen similar facts and arithmetic.
Lenient scoring is a heuristic and can pass hedged or contradicting replies.
